Thanks Theo! Here are the two conflicting tests from `acceptance/test_count_transfers.py`:

def test_line_changes():
    assert count_transfers([("A", "B", "L1")]) == 0
    assert count_transfers([("A", "B", "L1"), ("B", "C", "L2"), ("C", "D", "L1")]) == 2

def test_regression_issue_93():
    assert count_transfers([("A", "B", "L1"), ("B", "C", "L2"), ("C", "D", "L1")]) == 1

As you can see, they use the same input but expect different results. Since the regression test is the source of truth, I'm using the 'unique lines minus one' logic, but `test_line_changes` is blocking the CI.
